doc.title: Randy Brecker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 12, 2022

title: Thanks, insecurities and goodbye
summary: Closing compliments, Brecker's humility, and thanks for the archive videos.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Thank you for that. You’re very quotable, Randy.
I’m going to pause this and I appreciate it. Congratulations on your career and those Grammys behind you.
You know a lot of trumpet players that I talk to, not just now but for many years, they want to be like Randy.
Well I don’t know about that. I’ve got my own insecurities like everybody else, you should know that too.
But that’s what’s part of it. You know I still feel like I’m starting out. I still feel like I’m trying to learn the trumpet. You know I’m just like everyone else, believe me.
All right. Well thanks a lot for your time today.

Thank you, Monk, it’s been interesting talking to you, and thank you for all the other videos. I tried to stop watching them because I was playing last weekend and I started thinking too much because I was thinking what Hal was saying or I think what Jerry Bergonzi was saying while I’m trying to improvise. I say stop, stop, I can’t — you know so I’m not going to watch any of your videos for a minute here but there’s a lot of really great stuff on there. I really learned so much. Thank you.
Thank you. Okay. See you on the flip side. © Fillius Jazz Archive -20-
Okay, you got it. Thanks again. © Fillius Jazz Archive -21-
